name: hash_verify
description: Verify a file against .sha256/.md5/.sha1 sidecars, SHA256SUMS (GNU/BSD) or an expected digest

path.description: file to verify, or a checksum file (SHA256SUMS, x.sha256) whose every entry is verified

sums.description: checksum file to read the expected digest from (default: <path>.sha256/.sha1/.md5 or SHA256SUMS/MD5SUMS/CHECKSUMS beside it)

algo.description: algorithm to use (default auto: from the BSD tag, file name or digest length)

expected.description: expected hex digest of path (32/40/64 chars); wins over sums and sidecars

results.reason: match|mismatch|file not found|not listed in ...|time budget ...|unreadable ...
